content.text: Unclear on slide (name runs over a petal's edge)
: protein synthesis inhibitor (binds to 30S ribosomal subunit); bacteriostatic
•broad spectrum of activity – good against gram (+), gram (-), atypical organisms, & organisms other than bacteria
•poor GI tolerance: may cause diarrhea & gastritis
•deposition in calcified tissue: deposition in teeth causes teeth discoloration & may affect growth (not usually given in children <8yo for >21d)
•impaired absorption if given w/ dairy products, Ca, Al, Mg, Fe

roles.drugs: Topical antibiotics: erythromycin 2% gel or cream BID

roles.drugs: No response or extensive: oral tetracyclines (doxycycline or minocycline 50–100 mg BID, or tetracycline 250–500 mg BID between meals) for 4 weeks, then taper to the lowest effective dose. Unlike acne, antibiotics can usually be stopped
